text:
Make `athena retry <job>` print, before any paid stage runs, the earlier attempt's stop reason and the mode the retry will use: merge a stale candidate, build on the rejected candidate and fix only the findings, or start over from the base. Also print an estimated cost range taken from earlier retries of the same mode. Add a `--dry-run` flag that prints this and exits without calling any model. Correct the retry help text in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs so it names all three modes, including building on the rejected candidate. Acceptance: (1) one test per mode shows `--dry-run` prints the right mode and stop reason and makes no model call; (2) a test shows the help text names all three modes; (3) a replay of the records of job 20261028-065911-m6m5 shows the printed mode is start over from the base, not reuse of kept work; (4) a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Retry mode and cost are stated from guesses because `athena retry` never shows them before it runs
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, CHANGELOG.md
